scenes.line1: What if data shows up late?
scenes.say: What happens when data arrives after your pipeline already ran? How do you keep your results accurate?

scenes.label: Late Data
scenes.sub: Data that arrives after its processing window
scenes.say: Late-arriving data means records show up after your usual processing window, often because of upstream delays.

rows.b: Watch for new data by date or ID
Update or insert to avoid duplicates

scenes.say: To handle late data, detect new arrivals for past dates, reprocess only what's affected, and use upserts to keep things clean.

scenes.title: Reprocessing a Partition
scenes.say: For example, if new records for June first arrive late, you can trigger your ETL job again just for that date.

scenes.question: What if you just append late data?
scenes.wrong: You risk duplicate or wrong results.
scenes.right: You need upserts or merges to avoid duplicates and keep your data correct.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: if you only append late data, you might get duplicates. Always use upserts or merges to keep your data right.
